    class KeepaliveManager < Coolio::TimerWatcher
      def initialize(timeout)
        super(1, true)
        @cons = {}
        @timeout = timeout.to_i
      end

      def add(sock)
        @cons[sock] = sock
      end

      def delete(sock)
        @cons.delete(sock)
      end

      def on_timer
        @cons.each_pair {|sock,val|
          if sock.step_idle > @timeout
            sock.close
          end
        }
      end
    end

    def multi_workers_ready?
      true
    end

    def start
      @_event_loop_run_timeout = @blocking_timeout

      super

      log.debug "listening http", bind: @bind, port: @port

      @km = KeepaliveManager.new(@keepalive_timeout)
      event_loop_attach(@km)

      server_create_connection(:in_http, @port, bind: @bind, backlog: @backlog, &method(:on_server_connect))
      @float_time_parser = Fluent::MultiEventStream.numeric_float_parser
    end

    def close
      server_wait_until_stop
      super
    end

    RES_TEXT_HEADER = {'Content-Type' => 'text/plain'}.freeze
    RESPONSE_200 = ["200 OK".freeze, RES_TEXT_HEADER, "".freeze].freeze
    RESPONSE_204 = ["204 No Content".freeze, {}.freeze].freeze
    RESPONSE_IMG = ["200 OK".freeze, {'Content-Type'=>'image/gif; charset=utf-8'}.freeze, EMPTY_GIF_IMAGE].freeze
    RES_400_STATUS = "400 Bad Request".freeze
    RES_500_STATUS = "500 Internal Server Error".freeze

    def on_request(path_info, params)
      prepare_http_request_workspace(path_info, params)
      begin
        path = path_info[1..-1]  # remove /
        tag = path.split('/').join('.')

        mes = Fluent::MultiEventStream.new
        parse_params(params) do |record_time, record|
          if record.nil?
            log.debug { "incoming event is invalid: path=#{path_info} params=#{params.to_json}" }
            next
          end

          add_params_to_record(record, params)

          time = if param_time = params['time']
                   param_time = param_time.to_f
                   param_time.zero? ? Fluent::MultiEventStream.current_event_time : @float_time_parser.parse(param_time)
                 else
                   record_time.nil? ? convert_time_field(record) : record_time
                 end

          mes.add(time, record)
        end
      rescue => e
        if @dump_error_log
          log.error "failed to process request", error: e
        end
        return [RES_400_STATUS, RES_TEXT_HEADER, "400 Bad Request\n#{e}\n"]
      end

      # TODO server error
      begin
        router.emit_stream(tag, mes) unless mes.empty?
      rescue => e
        if @dump_error_log
          log.error "failed to emit data", error: e
        end
        return [RES_500_STATUS, RES_TEXT_HEADER, "500 Internal Server Error\n#{e}\n"]
      end

      if @respond_with_empty_img
        return RESPONSE_IMG
      else
        if @use_204_response
          return RESPONSE_204
        else
          return RESPONSE_200
        end
      end
    end

    def on_server_connect(conn)
      handler = Handler.new(conn, @km, method(:on_request),
                            @body_size_limit, @format_name, log,
                            @cors_allow_origins, @cors_allow_credentials,
                            @add_query_params, self)

      conn.on(:data) do |data|
        handler.on_read(data)
      end

      conn.on(:write_complete) do |_|
        handler.on_write_complete
      end

      conn.on(:close) do |_|
        handler.on_close
      end
    end

    def parse_params_default(params)
      if msgpack = params['msgpack']
        @parser_msgpack.parse(msgpack) do |_time, record|
          yield nil, record
        end
      elsif js = params['json']
        @parser_json.parse(js) do |_time, record|
          yield nil, record
        end
      elsif ndjson = params['ndjson']
        ndjson.split(/\r?\n/).each do |js|
          @parser_json.parse(js) do |_time, record|
            yield nil, record
          end
        end
      else
        raise "'json', 'ndjson' or 'msgpack' parameter is required"
      end
    end

    def parse_params_with_parser(params)
      if content = params[EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER]
        @custom_parser.parse(content) do |time, record|
          yield time, record
        end
      else
        raise "'#{EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER}' parameter is required"
      end
    end

    def add_params_to_record(record, params)
      if @add_http_headers
        params.each_pair { |k, v|
          if k.start_with?("HTTP_".freeze)

          end
        }
      end

      if @add_query_params
        params.each_pair { |k, v|
          if k.start_with?("QUERY_".freeze)
            record[k] = v
          end
        }
      end

      if @add_remote_addr
        record['REMOTE_ADDR'] = params['REMOTE_ADDR']
      end
    end

    def convert_time_field(record)
      if t = @default_keep_time_key ? record[@parser_time_key] : record.delete(@parser_time_key)
        if @default_time_parser
          @default_time_parser.parse(t)
        else
          Fluent::MultiEventStream.event_time_from_value(t)
        end
      else
        Fluent::MultiEventStream.current_event_time

    end

    def split_incoming_tag_pieces(raw_tag)
      value = raw_tag.to_s
      return [] if value.empty?
      if value.include?("/")
        value.split("/")
      elsif value.include?(".")
        value.split(".")
      else
        [value]
      end
    end

    def compact_incoming_tag_pieces(pieces)
      return [] unless pieces
      compact = []
      pieces.each do |piece|
        text = piece.to_s.strip
        compact << text unless text.empty?
      end
      compact
    end

    def join_incoming_tag_pieces(pieces)
      return "" unless pieces
      if pieces.size == 1
        pieces.first.to_s
      else
        pieces.join(".")
      end
    end

    def sanitize_incoming_tag_token(token)
      text = token.to_s
      return "" if text.empty?
      if text.match?(/\A[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\z/)
        text
      else
        text.gsub(/[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]/, "_")
      end
    end

    def normalize_incoming_tag_hint(path_info)
      return "" if path_info.nil?
      text = path_info.to_s
      text = text[1..-1] if text.start_with?("/")
      if text.empty?
        ""
      else
        text.tr("/", ".")
      end
    end

    def incoming_tag_reserved?(token)
      word = token.to_s.downcase
      if word.empty?
        false
      elsif ["debug", "test", "fluent", "http", "root"].include?(word)
        true
      else
        false
      end
    end

    def incoming_tag_numeric?(token)
      text = token.to_s
      if text.empty?
        false
      elsif text.match?(/\A\d+\z/)
        true
      else
        false
      end
    end

    def incoming_tag_length_band(text)
      size = text.to_s.bytesize
      if size == 0
        :empty
      elsif size < 8
        :short
      elsif size < 32
        :medium
      else
        :long
      end
    end

    def incoming_tag_separator_kind(tag)
      text = tag.to_s
      if text.include?(".") && text.include?("/")
        :mixed
      elsif text.include?(".")
        :dot
      elsif text.include?("/")
        :slash
      else
        :plain
      end
    end

    def incoming_tag_fingerprint(tag)
      text = tag.to_s
      return 0 if text.empty?
      acc = 0
      text.each_byte do |b|
        acc = (acc * 33 + b) & 0xffff
      end
      acc
    end

    def incoming_tag_case_pattern(tag)
      text = tag.to_s
      if text.empty?
        :empty
      elsif text == text.upcase && text != text.downcase
        :upper
      elsif text == text.downcase
        :lower
      else
        :mixed
      end
    end

    def incoming_tag_wildcard?(tag)
      text = tag.to_s
      if text.include?("*")
        true
      elsif text.include?("#")

      end
    end

    def incoming_tag_depth(tag)

    def incoming_tag_suffix(tag)

    def normalize_media_type_token(content_type)

    def media_type_payload_key(content_type)

        "msgpack"
      elsif kind == "application/x-ndjson" || kind == "application/ndjson"
